description:
Port upstream's buffer+viewport architecture (pi-mono tui.ts:870-1204).

Currently fit_to_height crops the line buffer to the last height lines, shifting indices every time content grows past the screen. This causes the diff to see "unchanged" content at shifted rows, leaving stale terminal content even with the corrected index-by-index diff algorithm.

Upstream approach:
- Keep the full line buffer (no cropping)
- Diff compares buffer-absolute indices (stable across frames)
- Track previousViewportTop, viewportTop, hardwareCursorRow in Renderer state
- Use \r\n at bottom of screen to trigger real terminal scrolling
- computeLineDiff converts buffer-absolute → screen-relative positions
- When firstChanged < prevViewportTop, trigger full redraw (change is in scrollback)

Key state to add to Renderer:
- previous_viewport_top :: non_neg_integer()
- hardware_cursor_row :: non_neg_integer()
- max_lines_rendered :: non_neg_integer()

Remove fit_to_height from Interactive.render/2. The Renderer handles viewport windowing internally.
title: Replace fit_to_height with viewport scrolling model
